cardOverview.overviewText: A Titan co-branded card offering shopping rewards at Titan outlets, milestone lifestyle vouchers, exclusive partner perks, and fashion-related privileges.

benefitRows.offer: There are no complimentary visits for SBI Card MILES.|Priority Pass membership fee is complimentary for the first two cardholder membership years.|The standard membership of the Priority Pass Program is provided only to the primary cardholder of SBI Card MILES.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Visit the Priority Pass activation page. Enter your membership number and validation code. If required, provide the last four digits of your payment card associated with the membership
